
  The bug: [38;5;153mslugify[39m claims to "strip punctuation" but its regex
  [38;5;153m[^a-z0-9]+[39m treats every non-ASCII letter as punctuation, so [38;5;153m'café[39m [38;5;153mau
[39m  [38;5;153mlait'[39m becomes [38;5;153mcaf-au-lait[39m. It lowercases Unicode correctly and then
  throws the letters away. Runner-up in the same file: [38;5;153mtruncate[39m
  slices by UTF-16 code unit and will chop an emoji in half
  ([38;5;153mtruncate('😀😀😀',[39m [38;5;153m2)[39m returns a lone surrogate plus the ellipsis),
  and a missing [38;5;153mmax[39m returns just [38;5;153m'…'[39m.
